verdict.rationale: Mastra has explicit suspend/resume primitives for agents and workflows with durable storage of execution state, purpose-built for human-in-the-loop approval flows (suspend() to pause, resume() to continue with human input, snapshots to persist state indefinitely), plus tool-level requireApproval with an approval chunk in the stream for approving/declining agent actions. missing for 10: independent hands-on developer account specifically confirming suspend/resume-for-approval works end-to-end in production.
